scope: Classification temporal diagnostic; no full-six qualification or champion replacement

input.record_id: identity and row-alignment checks only; never a feature

target_protocol.metric: Macro F1 primary; precision, recall, confusion matrix, ROC AUC, average precision, log loss, and Brier descriptive

arms.bag: Existing C2_B LogisticRegression with unordered unigram/bigram TF-IDF and expanded structured features
arms.position: Same C2_B matrix plus three third-position unigram blocks
arms.shuffled_position: Same C2_B matrix plus position blocks after deterministic seed-42 within-document shuffle; shuffle affects only positional input
arms.missing_hgb: Existing C1_B structured HistGradientBoosting expert for stream-missing rows, shared identically across routes

position_block.tokenization: Existing C2_B word analyzer; _text_values; lowercase; Unicode accent stripping; default sklearn word token pattern
position_block.segment_rule: third(i)=floor(3*i/n), zero-based; empty streams have zero block
position_block.vocabulary: Only unigram entries in the shared fit-prefix C2_B mixed unigram/bigram vocabulary
position_block.normalization: Concatenate all three blocks then one per-row L2 normalization; preserve zero rows; no further global scaling
position_block.shuffle: Existing deterministic_order_shuffle(seed=42, stable normalized-text digest), no record_id/target input, preserving bag, token length, and exact segment sizes

c2b.structured: EXPANDED_FEATURES; existing fit-only HGBPreprocessor state; StandardScaler on numeric positions; OneHotEncoder(min_frequency=30,max_categories=254,handle_unknown=infrequent_if_exist); missing-stream indicator

gates.pass_interpretation: Mechanism advances for review only; not full-six qualified, not champion replacement, and not A02 replacement
gates.failure_interpretation: Retire exact three-third recipe; no bin/seed/C/vocabulary/block-weight sweeps
